title: Deconstructing NLG Evaluation: Evaluation Practices, Assumptions, and Their Implications

bias_targets.methodology: A mixed-methods study (semi-structured interviews and surveys) of NLG practitioners to investigate whether and how they conceptualize, measure, and mitigate allocational and representational harms in their systems.
Surveying and interviewing practitioners to determine the frequency and methods used (e.g., blocklists, classifiers) to evaluate and prevent toxic, hateful, or offensive speech in model outputs.

Investigating practitioner assumptions and evaluations regarding standard language ideologies (e.g., treating Mainstream U.S. English as default), 'neutral' voice, and whether teams systematically measure linguistic style, tone, or topic representation to detect the erasure of minoritized language varieties.
